factor_name: Three-session persistent elevated-VIX residual reversal scaled by downside volatility

calculation.expression: if VIX[t-1], VIX[t-2], and VIX[t-3] each exceed trailing-60-session VIX median: -(asset_return_10d - cross_sectional_median(asset_return_10d)) / downside_volatility_20d; otherwise inactive
calculation.description: At each decision date, use only completed observations through t-1. During a three-session persistent elevated-VIX regime, rank the contrarian ten-session cross-asset residual return, scaled by each asset's trailing 20-session downside volatility. Higher values indicate stronger expected five-session forward return. VIX is observation-only.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across the full synthetic history and separately over 2027-2030. Signal is active only in persistent elevated-VIX conditions; recent performance remains positive but weaker than full-sample performance, so use as a conditional overlay.
